title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
summary: Gears of War: E-Day leads the charge on GeForce NOW this week. Plus, discover 10 new games streaming from the cloud this week.
body_markdown:
*Gears of War: E-Day* leads the charge on


[GeForce NOW](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) this week, bringing Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago’s first fight against the Locust Horde to the cloud with GeForce RTX-powered performance.


A new way to join the action is also coming: Fire TV users will soon be able to purchase GeForce NOW memberships


[directly through Amazon](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-gamescom-2026) , creating a more seamless path from device setup to gameplay. Keep an eye out for availability in the coming weeks.


There’s more in store this GFN Thursday, with the cloud serving up 10 games, including seven new releases.


## **Emergence Day Is Here**


*Gears of War: E-Day* is now streaming on GeForce NOW following its global release on Tuesday, Oct. 6. Set 14 years before the original


*Gears of War* , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day.


The series’ brutal combat, desperate survival and larger-than-life action return with a new origin story for the legendary partnership. Ultimate members can take on the Horde with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, plus technologies including


[NVIDIA DLSS](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/dlss/) and


[NVIDIA Reflex](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/reflex/) .


From campaign missions to cooperative and competitive modes, GeForce NOW keeps the fight ready across low-power laptops, Macs, mobile devices, handhelds,


[Firefox](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-firefox/) and other browsers, and more — no massive downloads or expensive gaming rig required.


## **New on the Cloud Menu**


Members can look forward to the following games joining the


[GeForce NOW library](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/games/) this week:


- *Gears of War: E-Day* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010850?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) and


[Xbox](https://www.xbox.com/games/store/gears-of-war-e-day/9n4pt8hgcdhq?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 6), available on Game Pass


- *STAR WARS: Galactic Racer* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078430?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 6)


- *Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551980?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 8)


- *Forever Ago* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1215940/) , Oct. 8)


- *Order of the Sinking Star* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/499170?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 8)


- *Silver Pines* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333000?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 8)


- *Permafrost* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254990?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Oct. 9)


- *Graveyard Keeper 2* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358690?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *Solasta II* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975950?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *Tyr* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445260?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


The Xbox version of *Dune: Awakening* didn’t join GeForce NOW in September as previously shared. Stay tuned to GFN Thursday for updates on game availability. **


Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after they are released and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates on announced titles.


Gamers who want to test out high-performance GeForce NOW cloud gaming can start with a


[day pass](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/?ncid=pa-srch-goog-673352&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=24109411186&gbraid=0AAAAAD4XAoGPVGKakiCteqkRtoF1Q-KSI&gclid=CjwKCAjws_DTBhB_EiwAXZknGUBjXpM5vNQvnwLXUGilFsIHBSkbKPfllg7RGpFFuQZv2GFityJC6BoCq8MQAvD_BwE) to try premium cloud gaming before committing to a membership. Better yet, the cost of the day pass can be applied toward a first monthly membership — making it easy to try GeForce RTX-powered cloud gaming with the latest releases, then level up for more.


What’s on the play list this weekend? Let us know on


[X](https://x.com/NVIDIAGFN?lang=en) or in the comments below.
